Using the inbuilt high-resolution 13-megapixel UHD camera, you can capture every detail, ensuring that remote participants feel connected and engaged during virtual meetings. With the six-microphone array, you can enjoy crystal-clear audio while maximizing voice recording and ensuring that every participant's input is heard clearly. The ZK-IWB86BP includes a split-screen display capability that allows for the simultaneous exhibition of two separate pictures side by side, improving meeting efficiency and enabling dynamic content sharing. The interactive flat panel features a dual system, with Windows compatibility available as an optional feature, allowing users to select the operating system that best matches their tastes and workflows. The introduction of a Type-C interface expands the ZK-IWB86BP's flexibility by providing a handy and contemporary connection option for compatible devices. The ZK-IWB86BP is an improved version of its predecessor, the ZK-IWB, with capabilities including split-screen display, OCR, and a Type-C interface that improve meeting efficiency and productivity. The 20 multi-touch points allow several users to input data at the same time, promoting a collaborative atmosphere in which ideas may flow freely. The ZK-IWB86BP enables smartphone mirroring inside the same network, allowing users to exchange information straight from their smartphones and improving the interactive and dynamic character of presentations.
